data.text: Implemented PhasedJob/PhasedJobHandler as a native JobHandler adapter: private work/finalization scopes borrow the same execution services; a required classifier accepts retained complete failure evidence and returns only JobFailure. Core lower-level scoped driver reuses command polling/destruction without a new execution engine; it is explicitly host-owned, not a cancellable application bracket. The protected adapter exposes no separate runner/waiter; native invocation death still interrupts finalization. Four focused integration tests passed including early errors, panic, work timeout, both-phase failures, borrowed checkpoint persistence, native finalizer deadline and invocation destruction. Core/adapter doctests and focused Clippy passed. Migrated the real single-dependency consumer to protected registration; source-copy/native verification underway. No public hard cuts; serde_json changes from optional test-only declaration to normal dependency already present transitively.

The Git-free single-facade consumer passed: 14 consumer tests, 3 harness tests and a Docker-backed run with two durable jobs plus PostgreSQL quota. Both jobs use PhasedJob and persist their finalization checkpoint. Updated the canonical facade example and integration/consumer guides to lead with PhasedJob; the manual APIs remain explicitly lower-level. Full verify is running; an initial file-budget subprocess-cleanup failure was reproduced and then passed on retry with no budget-policy changes.

User explicitly rejected compatibility paths and requested a hard cutover for every consumer. Removing Bulkhead::enter entirely, migrating fixtures to parked execution rather than raw permits, and migrating all application callers. Durable transaction consumers require the existing retained-outcome resolver semantics to be available inside owned admission. The prior full verification was stopped at the workspace matrix because this scope change invalidates it.

User requested a hard cutover, rejecting source-compatible lower-level paths. Removing public job_phases and migrating native handler consumers to PhasedJob, including the reference provider protocol and test harnesses. Existing published raw-phase composition will have no deprecated shim because it restores the skipped-finalization ordering. PR 106 remains draft during cutover.

Removed public Bulkhead::enter with no shim; all source callers now use owned execution. Test-only capacity fixtures park a real Bulkhead::run future. Added run_resolved to retain the existing transaction evidence resolver inside admission, and migrated reference HTTP submission rather than wrapping it in a second cancellation boundary. Core all-feature lib/integration tests passed after migrating no-timer capacity probes and explicitly asserting parked-work telemetry. Seven async-bulkhead cases now cover retained outcome resolution as well as lifetime/refusal.

Public job_phases is now private with no alias or shim. All consumers use PhasedJob; the reference handler builds an invocation-local borrowed adapter and returns typed provider actions for finalization to persist. Existing private bridge and native harness regressions were moved to crate-internal test modules, retaining their assertions. Reference library: 65 passed, 2 explicitly live-only ignored. Runledger lib/integration suite and core/adapter/facade doctests passed. Focused live provider tests, public API diff and final full verification are in progress.

The public API surface comparison confirms Bulkhead::enter is the sole removed core API name; run/run_resolved replace it, without any raw-permit alias. Workspace all-feature Clippy passes. Initial full verification hit the previously reproduced Jig subprocess-cleanup error before checks; the unchanged retry passed file budgets and is continuing. Evidence is in docs/evidence/public-api-diff-2026-11-06.

The public API surface comparison confirms removal of job_phases and its re-export, with no other existing public signature changes. Four focused PostgreSQL scenarios passed: provider crash/restart, provider outcome contracts, delivery reconciliation, and provider state lock/retry boundaries. All 14 migrated external-consumer unit tests now pass after preserving timeout classification for adapter-owned interruptions and correcting the native-cutoff probe; Docker harness and full verification continue.

Removed Bulkhead::enter and migrated all consumers to owned run/run_resolved/run_blocking. Regression coverage includes capacity lifetime through destruction, late grants, refusal, deadline sharing, panic/error release and retained-outcome resolution. Delivered in https://github.com/bpcakes/batter/pull/106 (ready for review), head 96cf213. Hard cutover; no deprecated shims. Linux validation on pinned Rust 1.98.1: scripts/verify.sh passed formatting, unchanged file budgets, four Clippy configurations and all six test-matrix parts. Strict rustdoc caught two stale Self::enter links; after that documentation-only correction, strict workspace rustdoc and all five HTTP smoke profiles passed. The successful matrix was not repeated. Four additional PostgreSQL provider/reconciliation scenarios passed. Git-free single-facade consumer passed 14 tests, three harness tests and both durable jobs with finalization checkpoints. Public API comparison is recorded in docs/evidence/public-api-diff-2026-11-06. Hosted CI for the final documentation-only commit is pending; no final-head hosted success claimed.
